project.name: Taiwan Stock Swing Strategy Analyzer (台股波段策略分析儀)
project.description: Taiwan stock swing trading and multi-layer verification platform, featuring TWSE/TPEx daily quote screening, point-in-time fundamental/chips verification, empirical factor scoring, backtesting, and AI advisor interpretation.

nodes.name: Market Data & Ingestion
nodes.summary: Handles Taiwan stock market data ingestion across TWSE, TPEx, and FinMind API. Enforces strict security filtering to only support common stocks while preserving point-in-time correctness for monthly revenues and quarterly financial statements.

businessRules: Only TWSE and TPEx common stocks supported; exclude ETFs, ETNs, warrants, and emerging stocks
Point-in-time correctness: monthly revenue published by 10th of following month; quarterly statements matched with zero lookahead bias
FinMind API rate quota (600 req/hr) management with automatic fallback to local SQLite cache
crossDomainInteractions: Provides historical price OHLCV and volume series to Strategy Analysis and Backtest & Research
Provides point-in-time revenue, balance sheet, and institutional chip data to Multi-Layer Evaluation
Provides batch daily quote summaries to Market Scanner for fast Stage 1 candidate screening

nodes.name: Fetch All-Market Daily Quotes
nodes.summary: Ingests daily closing prices and trading volumes for all listed securities from TWSE and TPEx exchanges and filters out non-common stocks.

nodes.name: Request TWSE Daily Quotes
nodes.summary: Downloads and parses the TWSE MI_INDEX daily market close table for all listed securities.

nodes.name: Request TPEx Daily Quotes
nodes.summary: Fetches TPEx over-the-counter daily closing quotes via OpenAPI with fallback to HTML parsing.

nodes.name: Filter Supported Common Stocks
nodes.summary: Applies security filtering rules to eliminate emerging stocks, ETFs, ETNs, and warrants.

nodes.name: Synchronize Historical Stock Datasets
nodes.summary: Synchronizes historical daily prices, monthly revenues, and balance sheets via FinMind with local SQLite caching and effective date tagging.

nodes.name: Check Local SQLite Cache
nodes.summary: Inspects existing SQLite database records to identify missing date ranges and avoid unnecessary API calls.

nodes.name: Fetch Datasets from FinMind API
nodes.summary: Retrieves incremental price, revenue, margin trading, and institutional investor datasets with quota checking.

nodes.name: Calculate Point-in-Time Effective Dates
nodes.summary: Assigns statutory announcement dates for revenue (10th of following month) and financial reports to prevent lookahead bias.

nodes.name: Persist to SQLite Cache
nodes.summary: Saves refreshed records and updates the metadata cache index with transaction safety.

nodes.name: Strategy Analysis & Multi-Layer Evaluation
nodes.summary: Conducts multi-layer quantitative evaluation on individual Taiwan stocks, combining technical indicators, fundamental growth, institutional chips, empirical factor scoring, and exchange tick-compliant exit rules.

businessRules: Fundamental layer requires YoY revenue growth > 0%, positive trailing 4Q EPS, and debt ratio <= 60%
Chips layer verifies 10-day foreign and investment trust net buying > 0 and controlled margin borrowing
Exit levels determined using 14-day ATR: stop loss at -2*ATR, profit target at +3*ATR, rounded to Taiwan exchange tick increments
Factor scoring applies frozen empirical weights derived from 5-year event studies with out-of-sample decile benchmarks
crossDomainInteractions: Consumes daily quotes and point-in-time data from Market Data
Feeds single stock evaluation signals and exit levels to Market Scanner and Watchlist Management
Supplies structured quantitative metrics and indicator summaries to AI Advisor

nodes.name: Evaluate Single Stock Analysis & Exits
nodes.summary: Executes full three-layer verification (fundamental, chips, technical), evaluates strategy buy signals, and calculates ATR-based exit levels.

nodes.name: Compute Technical Indicators
nodes.summary: Calculates moving averages (MA5/20/60), ATR14, RSI, MACD, KD, and volume expansion indicators.

nodes.name: Evaluate Fundamental and Chips Layers
nodes.summary: Evaluates YoY revenue growth, trailing 4Q EPS, debt ratio, and 10-day institutional chip accumulation using pd.merge_asof.

nodes.name: Evaluate Trading Strategies
nodes.summary: Tests trigger conditions across 5 swing strategies: trend pullback, 20-day breakout, MACD cross, KD cross, and Bollinger breakout.

nodes.name: Calculate ATR Exits and Round to Tick
nodes.summary: Calculates stop loss at entry - 2*ATR, take profit at entry + 3*ATR, and rounds to Taiwan stock tick boundaries.

nodes.name: Assemble Today Analysis Summary
nodes.summary: Aggregates layer evaluations, strategy signals, backtest statistics, and exit plans into a unified TodayAnalysis object.

nodes.name: Calculate Multi-Factor Score & Decile
nodes.summary: Computes composite multi-factor score from empirical event-study weights and assigns the stock to its performance decile.

nodes.name: Extract Quantitative Factor Signals
nodes.summary: Evaluates 15 factor criteria including Relative Strength (RS), 20-day breakout, revenue acceleration, and institutional volume ratio.

nodes.name: Apply Frozen Empirical Weights
nodes.summary: Multiplies triggered factors by weights calibrated over 5-year event study to generate raw composite score.

nodes.name: Normalize Score and Map Decile Benchmark
nodes.summary: Normalizes score to 0-100 scale and looks up out-of-sample benchmark hit rate and lift multiplier.

nodes.name: Market Scanner & Nightly Plan
nodes.summary: Executes broad two-stage screening across the entire universe of ~2,000 Taiwan common stocks and powers scheduled nightly batch scans with real-time SSE streaming updates.

businessRules: Stage 1 filters entire market on trading volume (>= 1,000 lots) and minimum price (>= 10 TWD) using fast quote summary
Stage 2 executes deep 3-layer analysis and backtest win rates on top candidate stocks
Automated nightly execution runs at 18:30 Taipei time on trading days to produce nightly swing trading candidate plans
crossDomainInteractions: Consumes all-market quote summaries from Market Data
Invokes Strategy Analysis for Stage 2 candidate evaluation
Exports qualified candidate setups directly to Watchlist Management

nodes.name: Run Two-Stage Market Scan
nodes.summary: Screens ~2,000 stocks with fast Stage 1 volume/price pre-filter, evaluates top candidates through 3-layer analysis in Stage 2, and streams progress.

nodes.name: Filter Stage 1 Stock Pool
nodes.summary: Scans all market quotes to filter for common stocks with volume >= 1000 lots and price >= 10 TWD, sorting by turnover.

nodes.name: Analyze Stage 2 Candidates
nodes.summary: Executes deep indicators, 3-layer verification, and factor scoring on shortlisted candidate stocks.

nodes.name: Rank Matched Candidates
nodes.summary: Sorts qualified setups primarily by multi-factor score descending, then by strategy win rate.

nodes.name: Stream Real-Time Scan Events
nodes.summary: Emits Server-Sent Events for start, progress, matched candidates, and completion.

nodes.name: Execute Nightly Scheduled Scan
nodes.summary: Executes automated after-market two-stage scan at 18:30 Taipei time on trading days and persists the nightly plan to cache.

nodes.name: Verify Trading Day and Schedule
nodes.summary: Checks Taipei timezone calendar to ensure current day is a valid market trading day.

nodes.name: Run Automated Two-Stage Scan
nodes.summary: Triggers run_two_stage_scan with latest market quotes and incremental FinMind synchronization.

nodes.name: Save Nightly Plan to Database
nodes.summary: Stores ranked candidate stocks and entry/exit setups into SQLite nightly_plan table for fast frontend retrieval.

nodes.name: Backtesting & Factor Research
nodes.summary: Simulates swing trading strategies with an event-driven daily state machine incorporating transaction fees, and performs out-of-sample factor event studies with purged cross-validation.

businessRules: Enter at next day open following a signal day; enforce non-overlapping positions per strategy
Incorporate Taiwan market trading costs: 0.1425% broker fee on buy/sell and 0.3% transaction tax on sell
Exit triggers prioritized: gap-down below stop loss, intraday stop loss hit, take profit target reached, or 20-day holding limit
Factor research utilizes purged training/testing splits to measure information coefficient (IC) and decile lift
crossDomainInteractions: Consumes historical prices and factor series from Market Data and Strategy Analysis
Provides backtest win rates and profit factors to Strategy Analysis and Market Scanner

nodes.name: Simulate Strategy Backtest
nodes.summary: Runs historical trade simulation on individual stocks across strategies using non-overlapping positions and realistic exit rules.

nodes.name: Generate Historical Strategy Signals
nodes.summary: Evaluates signal rules across historical OHLCV data to locate buy entry dates.

nodes.name: Simulate Daily State Machine Trades
nodes.summary: Executes daily trade transitions: next-day open entry, ATR stop loss/take profit checks, 20-day max holding, and transaction fee deduction.

nodes.name: Compute Performance Statistics
nodes.summary: Calculates total trades, win rate %, profit factor, max drawdown %, and equity curve time series.

nodes.name: Run Factor Event Study & Research Report
nodes.summary: Conducts statistical event studies on stock selection factors across 5 years with purged train/test splitting and lift calculation.

nodes.name: Load Dataset and Purged Split
nodes.summary: Configures train period (2021-2024), test period (2025+), and 20-day purge buffer to eliminate label leakage.

nodes.name: Compute Forward Return Labels
nodes.summary: Calculates 20-day forward return outcomes, +15% target gains, and -7% stop-loss events for every trading day.

nodes.name: Calculate Factor Lift and Confidence Intervals
nodes.summary: Computes hit rates, benchmark baselines, lift multipliers, and 95% Wilson score confidence intervals for all candidate factors.

nodes.name: Watchlist & Portfolio Tracking
nodes.summary: Provides personalized tracking for shortlisted swing trading candidates, custom user groups, entry targets, and synchronized live market quote updates.

businessRules: Prevent duplicate stock entries in watchlist
Allow arbitrary tagging of stocks into multiple custom watchlist groups
Batch update returns, current price, and strategy trigger alerts against the latest market prices
crossDomainInteractions: Receives candidate additions from Market Scanner and Strategy Analysis
Queries Market Data for batch price updates and returns calculations

nodes.name: Manage Watchlist Items and Groups
nodes.summary: Enables users to add stocks to watchlist, assign them to custom groups, edit target levels, and remove tracked stocks.

nodes.name: Validate Stock and Lookup Baseline
nodes.summary: Validates stock code, retrieves official stock name, and auto-populates initial baseline price.

nodes.name: Persist Watchlist Record and Groups
nodes.summary: Inserts or updates the watchlist item with stop loss, target profit, notes, and group relations in SQLite.

nodes.name: Synchronize Watchlist Market Data
nodes.summary: Batch updates all watchlist stocks with current market prices, calculated returns %, and updated strategy trigger statuses.

nodes.name: Load Watchlist Stocks
nodes.summary: Retrieves the list of active tracked stocks and their entry prices from SQLite.

nodes.name: Fetch Latest Quotes and Compute Returns
nodes.summary: Batch fetches the latest quotes from TWSE/TPEx and recalculates change % and return % for each watchlist item.

nodes.name: AI Strategy Advisor
nodes.summary: Integrates Google Gemini to translate quantitative indicators, multi-layer verification results, and historical backtest metrics into structured narrative trading advice via Server-Sent Events.

businessRules: Mandatory compliance disclaimer: advisory statements are academic quantitative research, not financial advice
Stream generated insights in real-time using Server-Sent Events (SSE)
Graceful fallback with clear configuration guidance when GEMINI_API_KEY is not configured
crossDomainInteractions: Ingests compiled TodayAnalysis and indicator records from Strategy Analysis
Delivers streaming narrative insights to Frontend UI

nodes.name: Generate Real-Time AI Swing Strategy Advice
nodes.summary: Constructs structured quantitative context and streams Gemini AI interpretation of entry/exit strategy setups via Server-Sent Events.

nodes.name: Verify Gemini API Configuration
nodes.summary: Checks GEMINI_API_KEY presence in environment, returning clear configuration instructions if missing.

nodes.name: Build Structured Quantitative Prompt
nodes.summary: Synthesizes latest technical indicators, 3-layer verification details, exit targets, and factor score into a structured prompt.

nodes.name: Stream Gemini AI Response Chunks
nodes.summary: Invokes Google Gemini streaming API and yields incremental text chunks formatted for SSE typewriter display.

edges.description: Provides price series and point-in-time financial/chip data for indicator calculation and multi-layer verification
Provides all-market daily quote summaries for fast Stage 1 volume and price screening
Provides latest prices for watchlist return calculation and real-time synchronization
Executes deep 3-layer analysis and factor scoring on Stage 2 candidate stocks
Supplies assembled indicator metrics, layer verification statuses, and exit plans for AI narrative synthesis
Supplies strategy trigger conditions and multi-factor signals for simulation and event studies
Provides empirical factor weights, decile benchmarks, and strategy win rates to the evaluation assembler
Allows one-click addition of screened candidate setups directly into tracked watchlists
